parameters_used_by_the_relay.include_action_items: boolean, default false: include the action items for each meeting
parameters_used_by_the_relay.created_after: string: meetings with created_at after this timestamp, e.g. 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z
parameters_used_by_the_relay.include_summary: boolean, default false, a heavy call; unavailable for OAuth connected apps

response.items: an array of meetings shaped like the webhook payload; action_items, default_summary and transcript are null unless asked for

pagination: responses include a next_cursor; pass it as the cursor query parameter for the next page; next_cursor is null on the last page
page_size: 10 per page, no larger (the FAQ's statement)
